keyEvents.text: Goal! Nice 1, Rennes 0. Elye Wahi (Nice) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Nice 1, Rennes 1. Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Aboubakar Nagida with a cross.
Goal! Nice 2, Rennes 1. Elye Wahi (Nice) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Nice 3, Rennes 1. Jonathan Clauss (Nice) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Elye Wahi.
Substitution, Rennes. Bryan Reynolds replaces Przemyslaw Frankowski.
Substitution, Rennes. Mahdi Camara replaces Adrien Thomasson.
Second Half begins Nice 3, Rennes 1.
Goal! Nice 4, Rennes 1. Mohammed Amoura (Nice) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Sofiane Diop.
Goal! Nice 4, Rennes 2. Boulaye Dia (Rennes) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Anthony Rouault (Rennes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Elye Wahi (Nice) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Rennes. Djaoui Cissé replaces Valentin Rongier.
Substitution, Rennes. Issa Soumaré replaces Boulaye Dia.
Substitution, Nice. Gauthier Hein replaces Sofiane Diop because of an injury.
Goal! Nice 5, Rennes 2. Elye Wahi (Nice) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Gauthier Hein.
Substitution, Rennes. Eliezer Mayenda replaces Mousa Al Tamari.
Substitution, Nice. Morgan Sanson replaces Djibril Coulibaly.
Charlie Cresswell (Rennes) is shown the yellow card.
Mohamed Abdelmonem (Nice) is shown the yellow card.
Mahdi Camara (Rennes) is shown the yellow card.
Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Nice. Hamza Koutoune replaces Jonathan Clauss.
Substitution, Nice. Nathan Ngoumou replaces Elye Wahi.
Mohammed Amoura (Nice) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Mahdi Camara (Rennes).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half ends, Nice 5, Rennes 2.
